scoring_justification: Direct recomputation of DFT energies is infeasible in the verifier; comparing reported values to paper gold with tolerances is the strongest feasible verification.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold reference values for adsorption energies, coadsorption energy, and energy barriers for the catalytic CO oxidation on TMPc sheets as reported in the paper.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper: Li & Sun, The superior catalytic CO oxidation capacity of a Cr-phthalocyanine porous sheet, Sci. Rep. 4, 4098 (2014). Adsorption energies extracted from Figure 2; coadsorption energy from text; energy barriers from Figures 4 and 5.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Digitized from paper figures and confirmed with text statements.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These values are the actual published data from the original DFT study, used as reference for reproduction.

outputs.description: JSON file containing computed adsorption energies (Eads), coadsorption energy (E_coad), and energy barriers (Ea) for CO oxidation on 2D TMPc sheets. All values are in eV.

output_contract.notes: The values are compared against paper-reported references with tolerances of 0.15 eV for adsorption/coadsorption energies and 0.10 eV for energy barriers. The coadsorption energy for CrPc must be negative.

steps.description: Compare each energy value to paper gold with tolerance; extra weight on coadsorption energy and on the highest barrier.
